teleports.name: Fairy rings
teleports.note: Completion proves network access; confirm manually if you reached the unlock during the quest. Bring a dramen/lunar staff unless exempt.

teleports.name: Spirit tree network
teleports.note: Individual quest or planted-tree destinations retain their own requirements.

teleports.name: Gnome gliders
teleports.note: Use the destination closest to the route; quest-specific stops remain separate.

teleports.name: Royal seed pod
teleports.note: Unlimited Grand Tree teleport; the quest reward is reclaimable.

teleports.name: Eternal teleport crystal
teleports.note: Unlimited crystal teleports. Prifddinas requires Song of the Elves; quest completion alone does not grant the eternal item.

teleports.name: Charged teleport crystals / rechargeable seeds
teleports.note: Prifddinas destination requires Song of the Elves. Seeds require recharging before travel; charges and fees are not simulated.

teleports.name: Eternal Slayer ring
teleports.note: Unlimited ring destinations; individual dungeon access requirements remain.

teleports.name: Charged Slayer rings
teleports.note: One ring charge per teleport; the Eternal ring is recorded separately.

teleports.name: Mythical cape
teleports.note: Reclaimable unlimited teleport to the Myths' Guild.

teleports.name: Drakan's medallion
teleports.note: Rechargeable medallion; Darkmeyer still requires Sins of the Father. Remote use and charge rules apply.

teleports.name: Enchanted lyre (i)
teleports.note: Unlimited lyre teleport to Rellekka; other destinations need their diary unlocks.

teleports.name: Charged enchanted lyre
teleports.note: Rellekka destination. Confirm charges before the trip.

teleports.name: Charged Xeric's talisman
teleports.note: Lookout/Glade/Inferno destinations; Xeric's Heart needs Architectural Alliance, recorded separately. Inert talismans do not count.

teleports.name: Xeric's Heart destination
teleports.note: Destination unlock only; also needs a charged or mounted talisman.

teleports.name: Mounted Xeric's talisman
teleports.note: Confirm your own accessible POH installation; a banked talisman does not prove a mounted one.

teleports.name: Charged Digsite pendants
teleports.note: Base Digsite destination; Fossil Island and Lithkren need separate destination unlocks.

teleports.name: Digsite pendant: Fossil Island destination
teleports.note: Confirm visiting the House on the Hill machinery; quest completion alone does not prove this destination.

teleports.name: Digsite pendant: Lithkren destination
teleports.note: Confirm using the pendant on the strange machine after the quest.

teleports.name: Rings of dueling
teleports.note: Castle Wars / Ferox Enclave destinations; one charge per teleport.

teleports.name: Games necklaces
teleports.note: Burthorpe and Barbarian Outpost routes; one charge per teleport.

teleports.name: Charged amulets of glory
teleports.note: Al Kharid, Draynor, Karamja and Edgeville routes; uncharged amulets do not prove teleport stock.

teleports.name: Charged skills necklaces
teleports.note: Guild destinations retain any entrance or quest requirements.

teleports.name: Necklaces of passage
teleports.note: Useful for Jorral's outpost and the desert eagle route.

teleports.name: Key master teleports
teleports.note: Direct Cerberus approach; requires the matching Slayer level/task.

teleports.name: Calcified moths
teleports.note: Cam Torum teleport; local dungeon requirements remain.

teleports.name: Piscatoris teleport scrolls
teleports.note: Scroll to the colony area, then travel to the cove.

teleports.name: Mos le'harmless teleport scrolls
teleports.note: Scroll consumed on use; bring cave supplies for cave horrors.

teleports.name: Guthixian temple teleports
teleports.note: Temple entrance route; Tormented demon encounter preparation remains.

teleports.name: Nardah teleport scrolls
teleports.note: Nardah arrival; desert travel and local entrances remain separate.

teleports.name: Lumbridge teleport tablets
teleports.note: Tablet consumed on use; no spellbook requirement.

teleports.name: Falador teleport tablets
teleports.note: Tablet consumed on use; no spellbook requirement.

teleports.name: Camelot teleport tablets
teleports.note: Tablet consumed on use; no spellbook requirement.

teleports.name: Kourend Castle teleport tablets
teleports.note: Confirm the tablet's requirements and destination; one tablet per trip.

teleports.name: Salve graveyard teleport tablets
teleports.note: Short walk to fairy ring CKS or Canifis; tablet consumed.

teleports.name: Desert amulet 4
teleports.note: Unlimited teleport directly to the Kalphite Cave. The elite diary reward item proves this capability.

teleports.name: Fairy ring BJQ repaired
teleports.note: Confirm repairing the Ancient Cavern fairy ring. General fairy-ring access alone does not prove this.

teleports.name: Fairy ring CIS unlocked
teleports.note: Confirm paying to activate the Arceuus fairy ring.

teleports.name: Fairy ring DLP unlocked
teleports.note: Confirm first mooring at Grimstone; general fairy-ring access does not prove the destination.
